rules.ambiguity: names in >1 country dropped unless the top country holds >= 10x the runner-up's population; admin-1 rows count as population 0, so any 15k+ city outranks a same-named admin-1 region abroad
rules.coverage: GeoNames name + asciiname only (no alternatenames): native-script forms (Cyrillic/Arabic/CJK/...) do not resolve here
